claims.summary: For compact binary PHP with n=2^ell holes and n+1 rows, every polynomial vanishing on the nonempty domain forbidding collisions in a proper hole subset B has an ordinary old NS certificate through ell times its degree.
claims.assessment: All-parameter pivot normal-form proof: eliminate a hole outside B in a satisfiable unary domain, use downward-closed standard monomials, then pull back by degree-ell label indicators. Row decoder composition is literal; quadratic generator images have degree-2ell certificates. All-hole B is excluded. Exact four-hole checks audit the encoding, not the general theorem.
claims.rationale: Route-specific logarithmic reduction cost for local PHP domains; no independent novelty or main lower-bound advance is claimed.
claims.next_action: Use the certified domains in the nested source transfer; source-wide hole support remains to be supplied.

claims.summary: A finite complete binary product-only DAG with block domains nested along dependencies, uniform old NS reduction cost mu*deg+lambda, degree-t local partitions and one common degree-k weight/reference maps of degree T0 transfers degree-D PC or NS proofs of old u to old proofs of fu through mu*((T0+t)*D+k)+lambda. One old coefficient image per block, induction on each domain, weighted actual companion certificates and original cofactor/inference costs prove the bound. Inputs cannot read raw earlier coefficients; proof cofactors can. Different local weights cannot replace the common weight.
claims.rationale: Removes a common-domain convenience while preserving complete source costs; a supplied support/partition hypothesis remains, so the Frege obligation is unchanged.
claims.next_action: Test an actual mixed source for a paid way of satisfying or bypassing the required local partitions.

claims.summary: Complete binary compact-PHP product-only sources with polynomial block inventory, accuracies at least 3ell, nested proper hole bags of size q<=n^eta polylog(n), and induced inputs equal to old-affine baselines plus bag-occupancy offsets exclude degree-D PC/NS refutations for D<=n^alpha polylog(n), 2alpha+eta<1. claims.assessment: Column-state selectors cost ell*q, reference inventory at most M*(n+2)^q, finite affine normalization gives k=T0=ceil(sqrt((n+1)*ln(4M0))), and the old ceiling ell*((k+ell*q)*D+k) is o(n). claims.next_action: Address globally supported affine baselines feeding later products by a paid restriction or actual companion relation.
